Snh. 12ᵃ (in a secret letter) ז׳ בא וכ׳ a couple (of scholars or messengers of Jewish authorities) came from Rakkath (Tiberias), and the eagle (Rome) caught them; a. fr.—בֶּן ז׳ partner, equal, match, counterpart.
<cite ref="Gittin 90b:3">Gitt. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>אין זה בן זוּגוֹ וכ׳</he> this (second husband) is not the equal of the first husband (is morally inferior).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:8">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>שאין לו בן ז׳</he> it (the seventh day) has no match (the week having three couples of days and one single day).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:8">Ib.</cite> <he>כ״י היא בן זוּגָךְ</he> the congregation of Israel be thy match.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7:4">Gen. R. s. 7</cite> <he>בהמות יש לו בן ז׳</he> the B’hemoth has a partner (is created male and female).—Pl. <he>זוּגוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אין להם בן ז׳</he> (for <he>בני זוג</he>, cmp. <cite ref="B01219"><he>ברזג</he></cite>) have no partners (females).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:31">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>שמים וארץ ז׳ וב׳</he> heaven and earth are couples, sun and moon are couples &c.—

Pes. 110ᵇ יש בו משום ז׳ the apprehension of danger from even numbers applies to it, v. זוֹגָא; a. fr.—Esp. Zugoth, the two chiefs (Nasi and Ab Beth Din) of the Supreme Court since its reorganization after Simon the Just (v.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:2">Ab. I, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:4">4</cite>, sq.).
Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ top וכל הז׳ היו וכ׳ were all the Zugoth no accomplished scholars? Ib. כל הז׳ שעמדו (Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 13 האשכולות).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:13">Ib.</cite> bot.; Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56ᵈ <he>העמיד ז׳</he> he (John Hyrcan) appointed double sets of guards.
